Fix (regex validation of YYYY-MM-DD + isNaN check + inline formError state) works correctly.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: user entered a non-ISO date (e.g. '31/12/2026') in due_date, and `new Date('31/12/2026T23:59:59Z').toISOString()` threw RangeError inside submit's try/catch, which was silently caught with only console.warn, so no UI feedback -> button appeared broken. Fix applied by E1: (1) regex `/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/` pre-validation, (2) isNaN(date.getTime()) sanity check, (3) new formError state rendered in testID='debt-form-error' box, (4) backend errors piped to same box. Verified working end-to-end.
